Behind the scenes

Life at Finout

PEOPLE FIRST

Why Finout?

At Finout, we understand that our employees are the most valuable thing we have, and it's not just a motto. We are a young startup, with a really pleasant and friendly working environment, generous perks, and very nice people (well, most of them).

PRESENCE

Where are we?

Our offices are located in the heart of Tel-Aviv and New York, where we maintain a warm and communal atmosphere. However, we also understand the importance of flexibility, so feel free to work from home a few days a week if that suits you better.

Our values

What we care about?

We win together

No silos, no excuses. Over-communicate, collaborate, and work as one team. Everyone are a resource for you.

Own it. Fail, learn, and take responsibility

We embrace challenges, take accountability, and grow from mistakes.

Listen to the customer, not the roadmap

Obsess, understand business value, and prioritize what truly matters.

Be laser focused

Execute, prioritize, cut the noise. Stay on course. Demand clarity when needed.

The FinOps platform for cloud and AI spend, with agents that find the savings and act on them, so your team stays lean, and your coverage doesn't.
